d: At Orange County Choppers, Rick Petko is known for his exceptional fabrication skills. Now, he gets to put his experience to work on a motorcycle that reflects his own design sensibilities. From planning the frame to shaping the gas tank and rear fender, Rick takes on every detail of his first ground-up custom chopper. With Paul Jr. offering guidance and Paul Sr. keeping a close eye on progress, the pressure is on to turn his vision into reality. Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 60 only on discovery+ India.
